flip: A single playing card flipped over on a wooden table, one crisp papery snap
deal: A single playing card slid quickly across a wooden tavern table, a soft swish
settle: Two playing cards laid together on a wooden table with a soft warm wooden tap and a tiny bright bell chime
cut: A small dagger drawn from a sheath and one sharp swift slash through paper
hit: A heavy fist thumping down on a wooden table, mugs rattling
block: A thick wooden tankard set down firmly on a table, one solid thud
heal: Ale poured from a jug into a pewter mug, a short gentle glug and fizz
coins: A few coins dropped into a glass tip jar, bright clinks
shuffle: A deck of playing cards riffle shuffled once and bridged
lock: A small iron padlock snapping shut, a heavy click
grudge: An ominous low muted bell with a faint breathy whisper, like a bad memory returning
cleared: A short cheerful medieval tavern victory flourish: a lute strum, a tin whistle trill and a small crowd cheering and banging mugs
defeat: A short sad descending fiddle phrase ending with a dagger thudding into wood
door: A heavy tavern door creaking open and a small brass bell above it jingling
pour: A mug of ale poured out onto wooden floorboards, a short splash
build: A carpenter hammering three quick nails and one satisfied knock on wood
